exposure: gestational age at induction of labor
cohort: 16,185 women delivering at Roskilde University Hospital
finding: Early induction of labor at 37 weeks of gestation in women with high-risk ICP (TBA ≥ 40 μmol/l) was not associated with detectable maternal-fetal disadvantages compared to induction of labor at term in women with low-risk ICP (TBA < 40 μmol/l).
